name: cafestock
description: Gestion commerciale offline — fournitures et consommables pour cafés

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,desktop -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:desktop
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @cafestock/api && npm run lint -w @cafestock/desktop && npm run lint -w @cafestock/shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cafestock/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cafestock/api && npm run typecheck -w @cafestock/desktop
